newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume down on weak demand.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume down on weak demand.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange fell on Friday due to thin demand, while prices rose on higher world market prices.

Traded volume shrank to 550 kilos from 697 kilos on Thursday. Gold closed at $369.60 an ounce, up from previous $369.25. In lira terms it closed at 1,244,100 lira per gram, up from previous 1,238,300.
Trade was 170 kilos in the first session when there was no dollar term trade and 380 kilos in the afternoon. 72.7 percent of the total turnover was in lira terms.
